entry.prompt: Wind-bent mountain larch: a stout trunk leaning slightly, four flat layered tiers of chunky foliage pads swept to one side by the wind, the top tier smallest, crown taller than wide. Low-poly game asset for a top-down strategy game, stylized painted realism that reads from above. Solid closed volumes, no needles, no thin branches, hard edges, flat faces. One tree about 3.5 m tall. Isolated, no ground, no base plate, no snow, no text.
entry.texture: Stylized matte painted colours, even lighting, no baked shadows. Foliage pads: dark cool pine green (#35573F) with lighter sunlit pad tops (#5E8058) and a faint warm ochre tinge at the tips (#8A8A4E). Trunk: weathered grey-brown bark (#6A5646) with pale silver wind-worn patches (#9E968A). Muted and cool to sit beside grey fieldstone and turf roofs. No snow, no cones, no text or logos.
